newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose on Thursday morning as Nikkei futures ended higher in Chicago than in Osaka on Wednesday, brokers said. But they said that due to a dearth of factors to lead stocks higher, the gains may not last for long.
As of 0021 GMT, the Nikkei average was up 85.01 points or 0.42 percent at 20,215.52. Its September futures were up 90 points at 20,220.
"The end of the trading month is near and there are no aggressive participants, which means trade will be slow," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
